name: Create or update a repository secret
description: Create or update a repository secret Creates or updates a repository secret with an encrypted value. PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/agents/secrets/{secret_name}

name: Create a repository variable
description: Create a repository variable Creates a repository variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow. POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/agents/variables
context:
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/agents/variables
Creates a repository variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow. Authenticated users must have collaborator access to a repository to create, update, or read variables. OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)

name: Delete a repository secret
description: Delete a repository secret Deletes a secret in a repository using the secret name. DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/agents/secrets/{secret_name}

name: Delete a repository variable
description: Delete a repository variable Deletes a repository variable using the variable name. DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/agents/variables/{name}

name: Get a repository public key
description: Get a repository public key Gets your public key, which you need to encrypt secrets. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/agents/secrets/public-key
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/agents/secrets/public-key
Gets your public key, which you need to encrypt secrets. You need to encrypt a secret before you can create or update secrets. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private, OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

name: Get a repository secret
description: Get a repository secret Gets a single repository secret without revealing its encrypted value. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/agents/secrets/{secret_name}

name: Get a repository variable
description: Get a repository variable Gets a specific variable in a repository. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/agents/variables/{name}
